meaning:
πλουτίζω
(πλοῦτος), [in LXX chiefly for עָשַׁר hi. ;]
to make rich, enrich: with accusative of person(s), pass., 2Co.9:11. Metaphorical, of spiritual riches, with accusative: of person(s), 2Co.6:10; before ἐν, pass., 1Co.1:5.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge;
as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
